checks: Three explicitly selected modes: frozen Assembly plus frozen cached scorer; frozen Assembly plus accepted Skellam scorer; EncodingAssembly plus the same accepted Skellam scorer. No shipping or benchmark encoder monkeypatch, function cloning, or global dispatch rebinding.

Each EncodingAssembly callback creates its own EncodingMemo inside the measured fit callback. Fit timing spans memo allocation, original fit/grid validation, snapshot/key/encoding, descriptor serialization, independent reconstruction, component/hash/moment checks, frozen law copies and full roundtrip. Original and candidate selected_native setup stays outside that same inherited callback boundary.

Eight fixed synthetic cases: 3/700 empirical atoms crossed with setting10 full/independent and setting6 two zero-update controls. Genuine tiny original/new trajectory histories supply z-target means. The benchmark explicitly constructs partial Assembly objects; it does not invoke historical admission or pretend to exercise the full chronological constructor.

One warmup per mode and six Latin-rotated measured rounds per case: each of three modes occupies each position twice, 21 pairs per case and 168 fit plus 168 complete score callbacks overall. Both original score flags are true; no metric subset or alternate score formula.

Each completed descriptor and full 104-field metric body, exact canonical hashes and recovered-law hash are saved to a unique exclusive observation path before post-score guards and reference comparisons. Reason/work/shared-binding diagnostics now survive a completed-callback mismatch. Strict JSON hashes retain signed-zero evidence even when ordinary Python float equality would not.

Every mode is immediately compared to the pinned accepted original reference, not merely to another candidate mode. Full descriptor/metric bodies and hashes plus recovered-law hash must match. No retry, alternative sample, tuning or favorable-timing selection is implemented.

The focused suite has 21 real tests with frozen functions as oracles. It challenges signed zeros, lengths, extreme/subnormal floats, mutation, eviction, unsupported object identity and errors, captured encoder and failed-encoding commit ordering; fresh instances and two genuine callbacks prove cache isolation.

Real component recovery tests prime cache hits, then change first/last alpha bits or length, flip signed zero, and corrupt saved alpha hash/beta/rates/mean/covariance. They require original exception class and message, spy fresh components/three hashes/six moments, compare all recovered field types/dtypes/shapes/C-bytes/writeability/scalars, and verify archive schema/class AdmissionFailure.

Real Assembly tests cover full, independence, 24-hour availability, both zero controls, no-eligible matched N0 fallback, fit/grid NumericalFailure, required-N0 failure, unexpected RuntimeError, full roundtrip corruption, unchanged source arrays/globals and inherited methods. Context-managed patches are restricted to the owned synthetic tests and restore original bindings.

Child asserts pinned Python/NumPy/SciPy/platform/isolation, authenticates inputs, runs only this focused module with failfast and no skips, then the benchmark and reauthentication. Parent authenticates and snapshots inputs before child, checks before/after map equality, monitors its owned child against 60 seconds and 1024 MiB, stops failures without retry, and retains log/process/test/case/observation evidence.

Final process success checks include complete elapsed time and observed child peak RSS. Source changes, unsuccessful/skipped tests, child stop or nonzero exit, reference mismatch and output serialization failures prevent qualification success.
